title: The Language of Rain
summary: A poetic meditation on rain as a form of communication and emotion, exploring its many moods and the sensations it evokes.

pages.text: Rain speaks in a language all its own. Sometimes it whispers, gentle and tender, against the window panes. Other times it roars, magnificent and fierce, drumming its ancient rhythm upon the roof.
pages.scene: Raindrops on a window with soft, diffused light showing different rain intensities

pages.text: In spring, rain arrives as a promise. Each drop carries the possibility of growth. Seedlings in the soil stretch and reach, drinking in the gift of moisture. The air becomes thick and alive with the scent of earth.
pages.scene: Spring rain nourishing sprouting seeds and young plants in rich soil

pages.text: Summer rain brings relief from the burning sun. It arrives like an embrace, cooling the heated ground. Steam rises where warm water touches hot earth. The world exhales, grateful and refreshed.
pages.scene: Heavy summer rain cooling the scorched earth, steam rising, puddles forming

pages.text: Autumn rain sounds different. It carries sadness and beauty at once. The drops tap softly on the thinning leaves. Each raindrop seems to whisper goodbye, falling like tears of change.
pages.scene: Autumn rain falling through gradually-thinning trees, leaves drifting downward

pages.text: Winter rain turns to sleet and then to snow. It becomes a blanket, covering everything in silence. The world grows quiet and still. Only the softest sounds pierce the thick whiteness.
pages.scene: Transition from rain to sleet to snow, the world becoming gradually covered and silent

pages.text: Some rain falls soft and kind. Some rain comes fierce and wild. Some rain is brief, a quick gift. Some rain lingers for days, patient and slow. Each type has its own meaning, its own message to tell.
pages.scene: A series of different rain scenes - gentle mist, downpour, brief shower, persistent drizzle

pages.text: After the rain comes stillness. Puddles reflect the clearing sky. Drops cling to spider webs like tiny pearls. The air tastes clean and new. Everything that was dry now glistens. Everything that was dusty now shines.
pages.scene: The magical moment after rain - glistening surfaces, clear sky, jeweled spider webs

pages.text: To listen to rain is to hear the voice of the earth itself. It speaks of thirst and satisfaction. It tells of cycles that turn and return. In the patient sound of falling water, we discover a language deeper than words.
pages.scene: Someone listening peacefully to rain, finding wisdom and tranquility in its sound
